meta.title: Equilibrium League Region Picker
meta.description: Set a title, pick your regions, screenshot, and share
meta.ogImageAlt: A Selection of Regions for RS3 Equilibrium League.

regions.name: Misthalin
toolTipItems: Covers the entire Kingdom of Misthalin.
Instances of areas in Misthalin and underground areas with an entrance in Misthalin will also be included.

regions.name: Havenhythe
toolTipItems: Includes the newly released Havenhythe continent.
Instances of areas in Havenhythe and underground areas with an entrance in Havenhythe will also be included.

regions.name: Karamja
toolTipItems: Covers the entire island of Karamja.
Instances of areas in Karamja and underground areas with an entrance in Karamja will also be included.

regions.name: Anachronia
toolTipItems: Covers the entire island of Anachronia.
Instances of areas in Anachronia and underground areas with an entrance in Anachronia will also be included.

regions.name: Asgarnia
toolTipItems: Covers the entire Kingdom of Asgarnia.
Instances of areas in Asgarnia and underground areas with an entrance in Asgarnia will also be included.

regions.name: Fremennik Province
toolTipItems: Covers the entire Fremennik province.
Instances of areas in Fremennik province and underground areas with an entrance in Fremennik province will also be included.

regions.name: Kandarin
toolTipItems: Covers the entire Kingdom of Kandarin.
Instances of areas in Kandarin and underground areas with an entrance in Kandarin will also be included.
The White Wolf Mountain underground is part of Kandarin, not Asgarnia.

regions.name: Kharidian Desert
toolTipItems: Covers the entire Kharidian Desert.
Instances of areas in the Kharidian Desert and underground areas with an entrance in the Kharidian Desert will also be included.

regions.name: Morytania
toolTipItems: Covers the entirety of Morytania along with the island of Mos Le'Harmless, Braindeath Island, Dragontooth Island and Harmony Island.
Instances of areas in Morytania and underground areas with an entrance in Morytania will also be included.

regions.name: Tirannwn
toolTipItems: Covers the entirety of Tirannwn along with the Temple of Light, The Lost Grove, the Poison Waste, the Underground Pass, and Prifddinas.
Instances of areas in Tirannwn and underground areas with an entrance in Tirannwn will also be included.

regions.name: Wilderness
toolTipItems: Covers the entirety of the Wilderness, including the Daemonheim peninsula.
Excludes the Mahjarrat Ritual Site and Fort Forinthry.
